intro.en: A reading passage about the bond between Islam and the Arabic language: the Quran was revealed in Arabic, and Islam carried Arabic to many lands and peoples.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein ek parhne ka matan hai jo Islam aur Arabi zubaan ke rishte ke bare mein hai: Quran Arabi mein nazil hua aur Islam ne Arabi ko bahut se mulkon aur qaumon tak pohanchaya.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلقِراءَةِ عَنِ الصِّلَةِ بَيْنَ الإِسْلامِ وَاللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ: نَزَلَ القُرْآنُ بِالعَرَبِيَّةِ، وَحَمَلَ الإِسْلامُ العَرَبِيَّةَ إِلى بُلْدانٍ وَشُعوبٍ كَثيرَةٍ.

dialogue.ar: أَلَيْسَ القُرْآنُ كِتابَ هذا الدِّينِ؟
dialogue.tr: a-laysa l-qurʾānu kitāba hādhā d-dīn?
dialogue.en: Is the Quran not the book of this religion?
dialogue.ur: Kya Quran is deen ki kitab nahin hai?

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ أَلَيْسَتِ العَرَبِيَّةُ لُغَةَ هذا الكِتابِ؟
dialogue.tr: thumma a-laysati l-ʿarabiyyatu lughata hādhā l-kitāb?
dialogue.en: And is Arabic not the language of this book?
dialogue.ur: Aur kya Arabi is kitab ki zubaan nahin hai?

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ ارْتِباطَ كِتابٍ سَماوِيٍّ مُنَزَّلٍ بِلُغَةٍ بِعَيْنِها أَمْرٌ لَمْ نَعْرِفْهُ لِغَيْرِ هذا الدِّينِ.
dialogue.tr: inna irtibāṭa kitābin samāwiyyin munazzalin bi-lughatin bi-ʿaynihā amrun lam naʿrifhu li-ghayri hādhā d-dīn
dialogue.en: A heavenly book tied to one particular language is something we have not known for any religion other than this one.
dialogue.ur: Ek aasmani kitab ka ek khaas zubaan se juda hona aisi baat hai jo hum is deen ke siwa kisi aur ke liye nahin jaante.

dialogue.ar: فَإِنَّ القُرْآنَ قُرْآنٌ بِلَفْظِهِ، وَنَصُّهُ لَمْ يُتَرْجَم، وَلا يُمْكِنُ أَنْ يُتَرْجَمَ.
dialogue.tr: fa-inna l-qurʾāna qurʾānun bi-lafẓih, wa naṣṣuhu lam yutarjam, wa lā yumkinu an yutarjam
dialogue.en: The Quran is the Quran in its very wording; its text has not been translated and cannot be translated.
dialogue.ur: Quran apne alfaz hi ke saath Quran hai; uska asal matan tarjuma nahin hua aur nahin ho sakta.

dialogue.ar: وَإِنْ تُرْجِمَتْ أَفْكارُهُ وَمَعانيهِ، فَهِيَ لا تُسَمّى قُرْآناً.
dialogue.tr: wa in turjimat afkāruhu wa maʿānīh, fa-hiya lā tusammā qurʾānan
dialogue.en: If its ideas and meanings are translated, those are not called the Quran.
dialogue.ur: Agar uske afkar aur maani ka tarjuma ho bhi jaye to use Quran nahin kaha jata.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ مِنْ أَثَرِ هذا الارْتِباطِ المُبارَكِ أَنْ عادَتْ عَلى اللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ جُهُودٌ وَثَمَراتٌ.
dialogue.tr: wa kāna min athari hādhā l-irtibāṭi l-mubārak an ʿādat ʿalā l-lughati l-ʿarabiyyati juhūdun wa thamarāt
dialogue.en: One effect of this blessed bond was that efforts and fruits came back to the Arabic language.
dialogue.ur: Is mubarak rishte ka ek asar yeh tha ke Arabi zubaan ko mehnaton aur phalon ka faida pohancha.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ مِنْ مَفاخِرِ اللِّسانِ العَرَبِيِّ أَنْ كانَ هُوَ لُغَةَ المُعْجِزَةِ الخالِدَةِ القُرْآنِ.
dialogue.tr: wa kāna min mafākhiri l-lisāni l-ʿarabiyyi an kāna huwa lughata l-muʿjizati l-khālidati l-qurʾān
dialogue.en: It is among the pride of the Arabic tongue that it is the language of the everlasting miracle, the Quran.
dialogue.ur: Arabi zubaan ke fakhar mein se hai ke woh hamesha rehne wale mojize, Quran, ki zubaan hai.

dialogue.ar: لَقَدْ شَدَّ الإِسْلامُ أَقْواماً غَيْرَ عَرَبٍ إِلى اللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: laqad shadda l-islāmu aqwāman ghayra ʿarabin ilā l-lughati l-ʿarabiyyah
dialogue.en: Islam drew non-Arab peoples towards the Arabic language.
dialogue.ur: Islam ne gair-Arab qaumon ko Arabi zubaan ki taraf khencha.

dialogue.ar: لَقَدْ خَرَجَتِ العَرَبِيَّةُ مِنْ جَزيرَةِ العَرَبِ مَعَ الفَتْحِ الإِسْلامِيِّ.
dialogue.tr: laqad kharajati l-ʿarabiyyatu min jazīrati l-ʿarabi maʿa l-fatḥi l-islāmī
dialogue.en: Arabic left the Arabian Peninsula with the Islamic conquest.
dialogue.ur: Arabi, Islami fatah ke saath jazeerat-ul-Arab se bahar nikli.

dialogue.ar: وَإِذا هِيَ تَتَعَدّى كَوْنَها لُغَةَ دينٍ إِلى كَوْنِها لُغَةَ شُعوبٍ وَدُوَلٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa idhā hiya tataʿaddā kawnahā lughata dīnin ilā kawnihā lughata shuʿūbin wa duwal
dialogue.en: It went beyond being the language of a religion to being the language of peoples and states.
dialogue.ur: Woh sirf deen ki zubaan hone se aage barh kar qaumon aur mulkon ki zubaan ban gayi.

dialogue.ar: وَما زالَ لِلإِسْلامِ أَثَرُهُ في نَشْرِ العَرَبِيَّةِ وَحِفْظِها في البِلادِ غَيْرِ العَرَبِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa mā zāla lil-islāmi atharuhu fī nashri l-ʿarabiyyati wa ḥifẓihā fī l-bilādi ghayri l-ʿarabiyyah
dialogue.en: Islam still has its effect in spreading Arabic and preserving it in non-Arab lands.
dialogue.ur: Islam ka asar aaj bhi gair-Arab mulkon mein Arabi phailane aur use mehfooz rakhne mein hai.

dialogue.ar: لَقَدِ اسْتَهْوَى الإِسْلامُ أَقْواماً؛ فَحَبَّبَ إِلَيْهِمْ لُغَتَهُ.
dialogue.tr: laqadi stahwā l-islāmu aqwāman; fa-ḥabbaba ilayhim lughatah
dialogue.en: Islam attracted peoples, so it made its language beloved to them.
dialogue.ur: Islam ne qaumon ko mutassir kiya, to unhein uski zubaan pyari bana di.

dialogue.ar: فَكانَتِ العَرَبِيَّةُ بِذلِكَ لِسانَ تِلْكَ الدَّعْوَةِ، وَلُغَةَ تِلْكَ الرِّسالَةِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-kānati l-ʿarabiyyatu bi-dhālika lisāna tilka d-daʿwah, wa lughata tilka r-risālah
dialogue.en: So Arabic became the tongue of that call and the language of that message.
dialogue.ur: Yun Arabi us dawat ki zubaan aur us paigham ki zubaan ban gayi.

q.en: What is the language of the Quran?
q.ur: Quran ki zubaan kaunsi hai?

q.en: According to the text, what happened to Arabic with the Islamic conquest?
q.ur: Matan ke mutabiq Islami fatah ke saath Arabi ke saath kya hua?
q.ar: ماذا حَدَثَ لِلُغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ مَعَ الفَتْحِ الإِسْلامِيِّ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

options: It was replaced by another language
options_ar: خَرَجَتْ مِنْ جَزيرَةِ العَرَبِ إِلى بُلْدانٍ كَثيرَةٍ

q.en: What does the text say about translating the Quran's wording?
q.ur: Quran ke alfaz ke tarjume ke bare mein matan kya kehta hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَقولُ النَّصُّ عَنْ تَرْجَمَةِ لَفْظِ القُرْآنِ؟

options: It was translated by the Arabs

q.en: Arabic became more than the language of a religion. It became the language of...
q.ur: Arabi sirf deen ki zubaan nahin rahi. Woh ban gayi...
q.ar: لَمْ تَبْقَ العَرَبِيَّةُ لُغَةَ دينٍ فَقَطْ، بَلْ صارَتْ لُغَةَ...

intro.en: The diminutive (التَّصْغير) makes a noun small or shows affection. A three-letter word follows the pattern فُعَيْل, e.g. قَلْب becomes قُلَيْب. Four-letter words follow فُعَيْعِل, e.g. مَنْزِل becomes مُنَيْزِل. Five-letter words with a long vowel follow فُعَيْعيل, e.g. عُصْفور becomes عُصَيْفير.
intro.ur: Tasgheer ka matlab kisi naam ko chhota ya pyara banana hai. Teen harf wale lafz ka wazn فُعَيْل hai, jaise قَلْب se قُلَيْب. Chaar harf wale ka wazn فُعَيْعِل hai, jaise مَنْزِل se مُنَيْزِل. Aur madd wale paanch harf wale ka wazn فُعَيْعيل hai, jaise عُصْفور se عُصَيْفير.
intro.ar: التَّصْغيرُ يَجْعَلُ الاسْمَ صَغيرًا أَوْ يُفيدُ التَّحَبُّبَ. الثُّلاثِيُّ عَلى وَزْنِ «فُعَيْل» مِثْلُ قَلْب: قُلَيْب، وَالرُّباعِيُّ عَلى «فُعَيْعِل» مِثْلُ مَنْزِل: مُنَيْزِل، وَما فيهِ حَرْفُ مَدٍّ عَلى «فُعَيْعيل» مِثْلُ عُصْفور: عُصَيْفير.

q.en: What is the diminutive of قَلْب (heart)?
q.ur: قَلْب ki tasgheer kya hai?

q.en: What is the diminutive of مَنْزِل (house)?
q.ur: مَنْزِل ki tasgheer kya hai?

q.en: The diminutive of عُصْفور (sparrow) is...
q.ur: عُصْفور ki tasgheer hai...

q.en: What is the pattern of the diminutive of a three-letter word?
q.ur: Teen harfi lafz ki tasgheer ka wazn kya hai?

title.en: Listening (1): The Story of the Revelation
title.ur: Sunna aur samajhna (1): Wahi ka waqia

intro.en: Listen to the story of how the revelation began, told by Khadijah, then mark each statement true or false. The first verses of the Quran called people to knowledge.
intro.ur: Wahi ke shuru hone ka waqia suniye, jise Sayyida Khadijah (RA) bayan karti hain, phir har jumle ko sahi ya ghalat nishan kijiye. Quran ki pehli aayaat ilm ki taraf bulati hain.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى قِصَّةِ بِدايَةِ الوَحْيِ كَما رَوَتْها خَديجَةُ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْها، ثُمَّ حَدِّدْ كُلَّ عِبارَةٍ صَوابًا أَوْ خَطَأً. دَعَتِ الآياتُ الأولى مِنَ القُرْآنِ النّاسَ إِلى العِلْمِ.

q.en: Who narrates the story of the revelation in the exercise?
q.ur: Mashq mein wahi ka waqia kaun bayan karta hai?
q.ar: مَنْ تَروي قِصَّةَ الوَحْيِ في التَّمْرينِ؟

q.en: How did the revelation begin?
q.ur: Wahi ka aaghaz kaise hua?

q.en: What did the first three verses of the Quran call people to?
q.ur: Quran ki pehli teen aayaat kis ki taraf bulati hain?
q.ar: إِلى ماذا دَعَتِ الآياتُ الثَّلاثُ الأولى مِنَ القُرْآنِ؟

q.en: The exercise asks: Waraqah ibn Nawfal knew which two languages?
q.ur: Mashq ke mutabiq Waraqah ibn Nawfal kaun si do zubaanein jaante the?
q.ar: يَسْأَلُ التَّمْرينُ: ما اللُّغَتانِ اللَّتانِ كانَ يَعْرِفُهُما وَرَقَةُ بْنُ نَوْفَلٍ؟

title.en: Listening (2): Features of the Message of Muhammad
title.ur: Sunna aur samajhna (2): Risalat-e-Muhammadi ki khusoosiyat

intro.en: Listen to a text about what makes the message of Muhammad ﷺ special, then judge the statements. The unit also includes a speaking drill: discuss either-or topics with a classmate.
intro.ur: Ek matan suniye jo Muhammad ﷺ ki risalat ki khusoosiyat ke bare mein hai, phir jumlon ko parkhiye. Is sabaq mein guftagu ki mashq bhi hai: 'ya yeh ya woh' mauzoo par saathi se baat kijiye.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى نَصٍّ عَنْ خَصائِصِ رِسالَةِ مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ ثُمَّ احْكُمْ عَلى العِباراتِ. وَفي الوَحْدَةِ أَيْضًا تَدْريبٌ عَلى الكَلامِ: ناقِشْ مَعَ زَميلٍ مَوْضوعاتٍ فيها اخْتِيارٌ بَيْنَ أَمْرَيْنِ.

q.en: What does the Arabic word رَسولٌ mean?
q.ur: Arabi lafz رَسولٌ ka kya matlab hai?

options_ar: مَنْ يَنْتَقِلُ مِنْ بَلَدٍ إِلى بَلَدٍ

q.en: What is the Arabic for 'private sector'?
q.ur: 'Private sector' ko Arabi mein kya kehte hain?
q.ar: ما القِطاعُ الَّذي تَمْلِكُهُ الشَّرِكاتُ وَالأَفْرادُ لا الحُكومَةُ؟

q.en: What is the meaning of السَّفَرُ?
q.ur: السَّفَرُ ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: What is the meaning of العَطاءُ?
q.ur: العَطاءُ ka matlab kya hai?

intro.en: The nisba is made by adding ـِيّ (-iyy) at the end of a noun to say a person or thing belongs to it. For example نَجْد (Najd) becomes نَجْدِيّ (from Najd), and عَرَب becomes عَرَبِيّ (Arab). Words ending in ة drop it first: مَكَّة becomes مَكِّيّ.
intro.ur: Nisbat banane ke liye lafz ke aakhir mein ـِيّ lagate hain, taake yeh batayein ke koi cheez ya shakhs us se talluq rakhta hai. Jaise نَجْد se نَجْدِيّ (Najd ka) aur عَرَب se عَرَبِيّ (Arab). Agar lafz ة par khatam ho to pehle ة hata dete hain: مَكَّة se مَكِّيّ.
intro.ar: نَصوغُ النَّسَبَ بِزِيادَةِ «ـِيّ» في آخِرِ الاسْمِ لِلدَّلالَةِ عَلى الانْتِماءِ إِلَيْهِ، مِثْلُ نَجْد: نَجْدِيّ، وَعَرَب: عَرَبِيّ. وَإِذا كانَ الاسْمُ مُنْتَهِيًا بِالتّاءِ المَرْبوطَةِ حَذَفْناها أَوَّلًا: مَكَّة: مَكِّيّ.

q.en: What is the nisba of عَرَب?
q.ur: عَرَب ki nisbat kya hai?

q.en: What is the nisba of بَغْداد?
q.ur: بَغْداد ki nisbat kya hai?

q.en: What is the nisba of مَكَّة?
q.ur: مَكَّة ki nisbat kya hai?

q.en: What do we add to make a nisba?
q.ur: Nisbat banane ke liye kya lagate hain?

options: ـِيّ at the end of the noun

title.en: Extended Reading: The Man of the Two Gardens
title.ur: Wasee mutalia: Do baghon wala shakhs

intro.en: A story from Surah al-Kahf (verses 31-44) about two brothers. One thanked Allah for his blessings; the other became proud and ungrateful, and lost everything. After the text come questions, exercises and a speaking drill.
intro.ur: Surah al-Kahf (aayat 31 se 44) ka ek qissa do bhaiyon ke bare mein. Ek ne Allah ki naimaton ka shukr kiya; doosra mutakabbir aur na-shukra ho gaya aur sab kuch kho baitha. Matan ke baad sawalat, mashqein aur guftagu hai.
intro.ar: قِصَّةٌ مِنْ سورَةِ الكَهْفِ (الآياتُ ٣١–٤٤) عَنْ أَخَوَيْنِ: شَكَرَ أَحَدُهُما اللهَ عَلى نِعَمِهِ، وَتَكَبَّرَ الآخَرُ وَجَحَدَ فَخَسِرَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ. وَبَعْدَ النَّصِّ أَسْئِلَةٌ وَتَمارينُ وَتَدْريبٌ عَلى الكَلامِ.

dialogue.ar: أَنْعَمَ اللهُ تَعالى عَلى رَجُلٍ مِنْ بَني إِسْرائيلَ، فَرَزَقَهُ ابْنَيْنِ رَبّاهُما.
dialogue.tr: anʿama llāhu taʿālā ʿalā rajulin min banī isrāʾīl, fa-razaqahu ibnayni rabbāhumā
dialogue.en: Allah blessed a man from the Children of Israel and gave him two sons whom he raised.
dialogue.ur: Allah ne Bani Israel ke ek shakhs par inaam kiya aur use do bete diye jinhein usne paala.

dialogue.ar: لَقَدْ عَلَّمَهُمَا الأَبُ زِراعَةَ الأَرْضِ.
dialogue.tr: laqad ʿallamahumā l-abu zirāʿata l-arḍ
dialogue.en: The father taught them farming.
dialogue.ur: Baap ne dono ko zameen ki kheti sikhai.

dialogue.ar: فَجَمَعَ وَلَدَيْهِ، وَنَصَحَهُما بِالاسْتِمْرارِ في العَمَلِ، وَالبُعْدِ عَنِ البَغْضاءِ وَالكَراهِيَةِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-jamaʿa waladayh, wa naṣaḥahumā bil-istimrāri fil-ʿamal, wal-buʿdi ʿani l-baghḍāʾi wal-karāhiya
dialogue.en: He gathered his two sons and advised them to keep working and to stay away from hatred and dislike.
dialogue.ur: Usne apne dono betoun ko jama kiya aur unhein kaam jaari rakhne aur nafrat aur bughz se door rehne ki nasihat ki.

dialogue.ar: مَاتَ الأَبُ، وَتَرَكَ لِوَلَدَيْهِ الأَراضِيَ وَالأَمْوالَ.
dialogue.tr: māta l-abu, wa taraka li-waladayhi l-arāḍiya wal-amwāl
dialogue.en: The father died and left his two sons the lands and the wealth.
dialogue.ur: Baap ka inteqal hua aur usne dono betoun ke liye zameenein aur maal chhoda.

dialogue.ar: وَحَمِدَ اللهَ عَلى ذلِكَ، وَشَكَرَهُ عَلى النِّعَمِ الكَثيرَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa ḥamida llāha ʿalā dhālik, wa shakarahu ʿalā n-niʿami l-kathīra
dialogue.en: The first brother praised Allah for that and thanked Him for the many blessings.
dialogue.ur: Pehle bhai ne is par Allah ki tareef ki aur bahut si naimaton par uska shukr ada kiya.

dialogue.ar: وَأَمَّا الوَلَدُ الآخَرُ فَلَمْ يَكُنْ مِثْلَ أَخيهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa ammā l-waladu l-ākharu fa-lam yakun mithla akhīh
dialogue.en: As for the other son, he was not like his brother.
dialogue.ur: Raha doosra beta, to woh apne bhai jaisa na tha.

dialogue.ar: فَكانَ إِذا رَأى مِسْكيناً أَغْمَضَ عَيْنَيْهِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-kāna idhā raʾā miskīnan aghmaḍa ʿaynayh
dialogue.en: When he saw a poor person he would shut his eyes.
dialogue.ur: Jab woh kisi miskeen ko dekhta to apni aankhein band kar leta.

dialogue.ar: وَكُلُّ هَمِّهِ أَنْ يُحافِظَ عَلى مالِهِ وَيَزيدَهُ.
dialogue.tr: wa kullu hammihi an yuḥāfiẓa ʿalā mālihi wa yazīdah
dialogue.en: All his concern was to protect his wealth and increase it.
dialogue.ur: Uski sari fikr yeh thi ke apne maal ki hifazat kare aur use barhaye.

dialogue.ar: وَجَعَلَ اللهُ لَهُ مِنَ البَساتينِ جَنَّتَيْنِ مِنْ أَجْمَلِ الجَنّاتِ، فيهِمَا العِنَبُ.
dialogue.tr: wa jaʿala llāhu lahu mina l-basātīni jannatayni min ajmali l-jannāt, fīhimā l-ʿinab
dialogue.en: Allah gave him two gardens among the most beautiful, with grapes in them.
dialogue.ur: Allah ne use baghon mein se do bahut khoobsurat bagh diye jin mein angoor the.

dialogue.ar: وَقالَ لِصاحِبِهِ وَهُوَ يُحاوِرُهُ: أَنَا أَكْثَرُ مِنْكَ مالاً وَأَعَزُّ نَفَراً.
dialogue.tr: wa qāla li-ṣāḥibihi wa huwa yuḥāwiruh: anā aktharu minka mālan wa aʿazzu nafarā
dialogue.en: He said to his companion while talking with him: I have more wealth than you and am stronger in followers.
dialogue.ur: Usne apne saathi se baat karte hue kaha: Main tum se zyada maal wala aur zyada izzat wala hoon.

dialogue.ar: وَإِنّي أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هذِهِ النِّعَمَ سَتَدومُ، وَما أَظُنُّ السّاعَةَ قائِمَةً.
dialogue.tr: wa innī aʿlamu anna hādhihi n-niʿama sa-tadūm, wa mā aẓunnu s-sāʿata qāʾima
dialogue.en: He said these blessings would last, and he did not think the Hour would come.
dialogue.ur: Usne kaha yeh naimatein hamesha rahengi aur main qayamat ko qaim hone wali nahin samajhta.

dialogue.ar: فَقالَ لَهُ أَخوهُ المُؤْمِنُ: أَكَفَرْتَ بِالَّذي خَلَقَكَ؟
dialogue.tr: fa-qāla lahu akhūhu l-muʾmin: a-kafarta bi-lladhī khalaqak?
dialogue.en: His believing brother said to him: Do you disbelieve in the One who created you?
dialogue.ur: Uske momin bhai ne kaha: Kya tu us zaat ka inkar karta hai jisne tujhe paida kiya?

dialogue.ar: أَلا تُفَكِّرُ أَنْ تَقولَ إِذا دَخَلْتَ جَنَّتَكَ: ما شاءَ اللهُ لا قُوَّةَ إِلاّ بِاللهِ؟
dialogue.tr: a-lā tufakkiru an taqūla idhā dakhalta jannataka: mā shāʾa llāhu lā quwwata illā billāh?
dialogue.en: Why do you not think to say, when you enter your garden: What Allah wills; there is no power except with Allah?
dialogue.ur: Tu yeh kyun nahin sochta ke jab apne bagh mein dakhil ho to kahe: Ma sha Allah, la quwwata illa billah?

dialogue.ar: وَلَمْ يَسْمَعِ الكافِرُ كَلامَ أَخيهِ المُؤْمِنِ، بَلِ ازْدادَ كُفْراً وَعِناداً.
dialogue.tr: wa lam yasmaʿi l-kāfiru kalāma akhīhi l-muʾmin, bali zdāda kufran wa ʿinādā
dialogue.en: The disbelieving brother did not listen to his believing brother; he only grew in disbelief and stubbornness.
dialogue.ur: Kafir bhai ne apne momin bhai ki baat nahin suni, balke kufr aur zid mein aur barh gaya.

dialogue.ar: وَأُحيطَ بِثَمَرِهِ، فَأَصْبَحَ يُقَلِّبُ كَفَّيْهِ عَلى ما أَنْفَقَ فيها.
dialogue.tr: wa uḥīṭa bi-thamarih, fa-aṣbaḥa yuqallibu kaffayhi ʿalā mā anfaqa fīhā
dialogue.en: His fruit was destroyed, and he began wringing his hands over what he had spent on it.
dialogue.ur: Uske phal tabah ho gaye aur woh apne haath malne laga us par jo usne us mein kharch kiya tha.

dialogue.ar: وَيَقولُ يا لَيْتَني لَمْ أُشْرِكْ بِرَبّي أَحَداً.
dialogue.tr: wa yaqūlu yā laytanī lam ushrik bi-rabbī aḥadā
dialogue.en: And he says: If only I had not associated anyone with my Lord.
dialogue.ur: Aur woh kehta hai: Kaash main apne Rab ke saath kisi ko shareek na thehrata.

dialogue.ar: هُنالِكَ الوَلايَةُ لِلّهِ الحَقِّ، هُوَ خَيْرٌ ثَواباً وَخَيْرٌ عُقْباً.
dialogue.tr: hunālika l-walāyatu lillāhi l-ḥaqq, huwa khayrun thawāban wa khayrun ʿuqbā
dialogue.en: There, authority belongs to Allah, the Truth; He is best in reward and best in outcome.
dialogue.ur: Wahan ikhtiyar Allah haq hi ka hai; woh sawab mein bhi behtar hai aur anjaam mein bhi behtar.

q.en: What did the father teach his two sons?
q.ur: Baap ne apne do betoun ko kya sikhaya?

q.en: How did the believing brother respond to his blessings?
q.ur: Momin bhai ne apni naimaton par kaisa rad-e-amal diya?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تَصَرَّفَ الأَخُ المُؤْمِنُ تِجاهَ نِعَمِهِ؟

q.en: What did the second brother do when he saw a poor person?
q.ur: Doosra bhai kisi miskeen ko dekhta to kya karta?
q.ar: ماذا فَعَلَ الأَخُ الثّاني حينَ رَأى فَقيرًا؟

q.en: What did Allah give the second brother?
q.ur: Allah ne doosre bhai ko kya diya?

options: Two gardens with grapes and date palms

q.en: What did the believing brother advise him to say on entering his garden?
q.ur: Momin bhai ne bagh mein dakhil hote waqt kya kehne ki nasihat ki?
q.ar: ماذا نَصَحَهُ أَخوهُ المُؤْمِنُ أَنْ يَقولَ عِنْدَ دُخولِ جَنَّتِهِ؟

options: ما شاءَ اللهُ لا قُوَّةَ إِلاّ بِاللهِ
